## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 107 captures during January 2025. Activity was completed in line with the planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issues reported.

The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The results below should be considered alongside the number of captures completed during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 107 captures, 11 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.3 per cent. The ungradable images should be reviewed through routine quality assurance processes to identify any recurring issues and support continued improvement in image acquisition.

## Grading

There were 22 referable results during January 2025. The median lag for grading was 6. This provides an overall measure of the time between capture and completion of grading. The site should continue to monitor grading timeliness and image quality through routine operational review, particularly where ungradable images may affect the progression of results.
